description: This Java source file defines a utility class `FineractClientHelper` that provides helper methods to create and configure instances of the `FineractClient` for integration testing purposes. It includes methods for obtaining default clients, creating new clients with custom configurations, and constructing URIs based on system properties. The class is part of the package `org.apache.fineract.integrationtests.common` and leverages external libraries such as OkHttp for HTTP logging and the Fineract client utilities.

classes.name: FineractClientHelper
